dict.string: Connect to your explicitly paired nearby phone to exchange encrypted location updates, including background updates when iOS permits.
Scan the other phone’s private QR to send a connection invitation.
While you enable Bluetooth location sharing, send fresh location readings to your paired nearby phone even with the screen locked. Turn sharing off in the app at any time.
Record your spoken question for on-device speech recognition.
Turn your spoken question into editable text using on-device speech recognition when available. Audio is not sent to an online transcription service.
